items.quote: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons
items.claim: Priestly coats were produced using woven work with fine linen

items.quote: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework
items.claim: A priestly girdle was constructed using needlework with colored threads on twined linen
